create_new_stream: create a new CUDA or CPU stream using the new_stream function with a torch.device
test_current_stream: test the current_stream function to get the active CUDA or CPU stream for a device
refactor_wait_stream: refactor wait_stream to synchronize a source CUDA stream waiting for a target CUDA stream
use_use_stream: use the use_stream context manager to execute code within a specific CUDA stream
build_record_stream: build tensor stream safety using record_stream to protect tensors against unexpected reallocation
